domain: Clears a bounded window-tile rectangle, fills its mirrored tilemap cells with the active border tile, and marks rendering dirty.
expressed: computes the 32-tile-wide destination cursor from the supplied tile coordinates
clamps width and height to the observed two-through-thirty range and the twenty-row screen bound
clears the corresponding tile attributes through UiWindow_ClearTileAttributesInRect
selects 0xF000 or 0xF07F from the render-menu state and current row
fills every requested row and advances by the remaining tilemap stride
